items.repair_path: Move worker-gate installation to the explicit WSGI composition boundary and keep an executable guard against production imports from sitecustomize.

items.repair_path: Stage an explicit Flask presentation registration or template migration with behavior-preserving tests before removing the compatibility patch.

items.violation: Legacy production composition shim spans Sources, Configuration, Observability, Auth, Account, Decision and Web and mutates app runtime seams after import.
items.repair_path: Freeze the existing direct app mutation surface; decompose only through staged explicit seams with compatibility proof.

items.violation: Application startup composes multiple domain schema owners and directly creates the Billing webhook event table.
items.repair_path: Persistence/Billing should own any semantic storage move; Architecture only freezes new cross-domain schema edges until an owner-approved staged migration exists.

items.violation: The API facade depends on private preload implementation details, including _preload._app.db() and the private _deadline_dt helper.
items.repair_path: Introduce or reuse an explicit public runtime/persistence seam, then remove private preload access with exact API behavior and startup-order proof.

items.violation: Runtime SCC spans app, company_profile and account_registry. app.init_db lazily imports both profile/account schema owners; company_profile.save_profile lazily writes into Account/Evaluation; account_registry imports app.APP at module load and dynamically reimports app for db(). Domain modules therefore depend upward on the root application while the root depends back on them.
items.repair_path: Keep the exact three-module SCC frozen. Stage explicit framework registration and persistence seams before removing upward app dependencies; route Company Profile -> Account/Evaluation semantic writes to Company State/Account owners; Account/Billing own entitlement semantics; Architecture owns dependency direction and cycle removal.

items.violation: The Mobile billing adapter is the sole direct react-native-purchases SDK importer, but raw RevenueCat model details still escape into BillingGate.js through managementURL, expirationDate, availablePackages, priceString and userCancelled.
items.repair_path: Preserve the existing SDK import boundary and freeze the exact leaked provider-model surface. Billing should add behavioral proof for native purchase/restore/cancel flows before Architecture normalizes provider objects into a provider-neutral Mobile billing surface.
